holds_without_pictures_note: Measured on scratch copies with media.photos emptied (charity1 + 5 test plans; local1): shots clean at 1440 and 390, legible ok. The opening is the deep ground with the heading (the reference's own sub-page header), the statement and the places run full width, the band is the plain tint, catalogue cards are deep panels in type, people stand in type on the deep ground. It reads as a plain, strongly coloured page of type; the template is chosen for its photographs, so offer it without them only when nothing picture-led qualifies.
